args.message:
Fix money rounding to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN)

FIN-212 requires banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN), but round_money
was using ROUND_HALF_UP. Switch the import and quantize call so that
halfway values round to the nearest even cent (e.g. 2.665 -> 2.66).

args.head: fix/bankers-rounding
args.title: Fix money rounding to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN)
args.body:
## Summary

The nightly build fails because `tests/test_money.py` expects banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`, per FIN-212), but `src/money.py` was using `ROUND_HALF_UP`.

## Change

- `src/money.py`: switch from `ROUND_HALF_UP` to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` in the import and in `round_money()`'s `quantize` call.

This makes halfway values round to the nearest even cent (e.g. `2.665 -> 2.66`), matching the test expectations and FIN-212.

## CI

CI run `ci-0001` passed on branch `fix/bankers-rounding`.

2. **Fixed it on a new branch** `fix/bankers-rounding`: changed `src/money.py` to use `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` in both the import and the `quantize` call.
